journal_entries.text: Signed up for the wellness program mostly for the sleep tracking. Felt fine this week, a bit tired from the move.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Baseline check-in; mild fatigue from relocation.

journal_entries.text: Unpacked the last box. Ran along the river for the first time here. Nice.
Started half marathon training. Legs are complaining, head is clear.
Dinner with the new team. I was nervous for about five minutes and then it was just dinner.
Quiet week. Read two books. Slept great.
Mom visited. Lovely but exhausting. Need a day to myself.
Long run, 14k. Cried a little at the end, the good kind.
Work got busy with the quarter end. Sleep a bit shorter. Still fine.
journal_entries.ai_summary: Transient work load; minor sleep impact.

journal_entries.text: Quarter closed. Took Friday off and did nothing. Perfect.
Race in two weeks. Tapering makes me antsy but it's a good antsy.
Ran the half. 1:58. Everyone came. Best day in a long time.
Post-race slump for a day, then fine. Thinking about what's next.

voice_notes.transcript: Hey, first note. Mostly good. Tired from unpacking. That's it.
Did my long run. Feeling strong. Honestly nothing to report.
Busy week at work, bit short on sleep. Nothing worrying.
Race day tomorrow. Nervous, excited, both.
Finished! I'm so happy. Okay bye.
Back to normal. Thinking about signing up for the full next year.
